t: 赵宽殷自称为宋太祖皇帝,结束后周并开始宋朝.
te: Zhao Kuangyin declares himself Emperor Taizu of Song, ending the Later Zhou and beginning the Song dynasty.
dz: 赵宽殷自称为宋太祖皇帝,结束后周并开始宋朝.
de: Zhao Kuangyin declares himself Emperor Taizu of Song, ending the Later Zhou and beginning the Song dynasty.

t: 巴西尔二世被加冕为拜占庭帝国同仁.
te: Basil II is crowned co-Emperor of the Byzantine Empire.
dz: 巴西尔二世被加冕为拜占庭帝国同仁.
de: Basil II is crowned co-Emperor of the Byzantine Empire.

t: 安德拉索斯战役(Battle of Andrass):列奥·普克斯(英语:Leo Phokas…
te: Byzantines under Leo Phokas the Younger score a crushing victory over the Hamdanid Emir of Aleppo, Sayf al-Dawla.
dz: 安德拉索斯战役(Battle of Andrass):列奥·普克斯(英语:Leo Phokas)"年轻"下拜占庭人得分,对阿勒颇的哈姆达尼德埃米尔赛义夫·阿道拉的压倒性胜利.
de: Battle of Andrassos: Byzantines under Leo Phokas the Younger score a crushing victory over the Hamdanid Emir of Aleppo, Sayf al-Dawla.
